verification_limits: This is an identity, attribution and sentence-support audit, not a systematic review, priority proof, implementation reproduction or independent validation of cited results.

Publisher/official pages sometimes challenge direct browser fetches. Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata was fetched successfully for all 17 DOI entries; cached primary search/PDF text and official author repositories supplied method descriptions.

Current NeurIPS official BibTeX downloads omit printed-volume page ranges. PyTorch's conventional retained range 8024-8035 is not newly established by the downloaded export; core author/title/year/venue identity is verified.

Dataset-specific preprocessing, counts, class maps, exact checkpoints, confidence rankings and this paper's formulas must remain supported by its executable artifacts; a background citation is not their verification.
precision_refinement_applied: The related-work sentence about Crowd-Calibrator now begins 'In its hate-speech comparison' to restrict the soft/categorical/MaxProb AUC/AUROC findings to the specific experiment supported by Sections 2.3 and 5.1. This is a factual scope narrowing in source/generated/related_work_revised.tex, not an experimental change.
